name: Omarchy Display Workspaces
author: nephilus (based on Omarchy)
description: Display workspace groups, optional automatic profiles, and session-only layout previews

barWidget.description: The green display highlight follows the cursor. Displays update automatically when connected or disconnected; Detect displays refreshes without clearing presentation preferences. Right-click a display for compact Displays, Workspaces, and Profiles tabs. Choose advertised resolution/refresh rate, scale, and placement; move workspace cards between displays. Manual Preview (20s) requires Apply to keep changes for this session only. New connectors can use native geometry-only output management without writing monitor rules; an on-demand session-lived worker retains the layout after Apply. Save current captures a named live arrangement, never draft edits. Profiles load manually into a draft. Optional automatic restoration requires explicit confirmation of a currently-live profile with unique make/model/serial identities; one automatic profile per complete display combination. Settled reconnects can restore it without another Apply click, with independent verification and Revert available for 20 seconds before automatic keep. Automatic display changes still require exact connector rules. Recovery is not guaranteed. Replacement disables automation; profile changes require guarded writes and exact backups. Names, icons, and display-group order save separately and immediately. Forget removes supported exact rules and matching preferences with confirmation, backups, and guarded recovery; active layout changes are possible. Unsafe rules or geometry are refused.
